strings: When r_c0 mews hello to m_c, m_c mews it back a dozen times. It seems {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/have/has} parrot chatter.
m_c often catches {PRONOUN/m_c/self} repeating the same word over and over. The medicine cat suggests it might be parrot chatter.
It's not uncommon for young kits to repeat words, but with m_c, it never seems to stop.
